title: Upper Lake & Lower Lake (Bhojtal), Bhopal - A Complete Travel Guide
content:
Upper Lake & Lower Lake (Bhojtal), Bhopal

Upper Lake and Lower Lake-together known as Bhojtal-form the heart of Bhopal. These two beautiful water bodies define the city’s charm, offering calm views, fresh air, and a peaceful escape from the busy city life. Surrounded by scenic ghats, gardens, and viewpoints, the lakes are perfect for photography, boating, evening walks, and family outings.

History & Significance

Upper Lake is one of India’s oldest man-made lakes, built in the 11th century by King Bhoj. Lower Lake was added later during the Mughal era. Together, they form a unique ecosystem that supports birds, aquatic plants, and the local community. Locals call it the “Bada Talab”, and it remains the pride of Bhopal.

Top Things to Do at Upper & Lower Lake

1. Boating at Upper Lake: Boating is the most popular activity-choose from paddle boats, motorboats, or speed boats. The views of the water, hills, and skyline are breathtaking, especially during sunset.

2. Visit Kamla Park: Located near the lake, Kamla Park offers lush gardens, walking tracks, and viewpoints where you can enjoy scenic lake views.

3. Watch the Sunset at VIP Road: VIP Road is one of the best sunset points in Bhopal. The reflection of the sky on the lake makes it a perfect photography spot.

4. Bird Watching: During winter, several migratory birds visit the lake area. Early morning is the best time to spot them.

5. Enjoy Street Food Near the Lake: Try Bhopal’s local snacks like chaat, corn, poha, and kulfi from vendors lined around the lakeside.

6. Visit Sair Sapata (for Families): This entertainment zone near Upper Lake offers food stalls, swings, hanging bridge, and boating-perfect for children and families.

Best Time to Visit

  • October to March is ideal because of the cool, pleasant weather.
  • Early mornings and late evenings offer the best lake views.

How to Reach

Upper and Lower Lakes are located near the centre of Bhopal.

  • Nearest Railway Station: Bhopal Junction (6-7 km)
  • Nearest Airport: Raja Bhoj Airport (12 km)
  • Auto, cab, and local buses are easily available.

Travel Tips

  • Visit during sunset for the best experience.
  • Carry a light jacket during winter evenings.
  • Weekends can be crowded-mornings are peaceful.
  • Keep the lake clean; avoid throwing waste.
  • For photography, early morning and golden-hour lighting is perfect.
excerpt: Upper Lake and Lower Lake, together known as Bhojtal, are the iconic lakes of Bhopal. These peaceful water bodies offer boating, scenic views, and beautiful sunset points. A must-visit destination for nature lovers, families, and photographers.
